desc.zh: 先以段落，再以句子分割，单句不能超过对应设置的字符最大数。参数说明：overlap应小于maxWordCount。
desc.en: First, divide into paragraphs, then further split into sentences. Each sentence must not exceed the corresponding maximum character count. Parameter description: overlap should be less than maxWordCount.

defaultArgs.description: 切片前后重叠的字符数量

desc.zh: 按段落与句子切分为定长切片，默认 512 字符、相邻切片不重叠；适用于表格、演示文稿与网页等格式。
desc.en: Split by paragraphs and sentences into fixed-length chunks, 512 characters by default with no overlap. Intended for spreadsheets, presentations and web pages.
